title: Moss and the Seed Trail
checkpoint: Phase 5 complete (School readiness) — Phonics Screening Check review week, practising across the whole code.
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 complete (School readiness) — Phonics Screening Check review week, practising across the whole code.

pages.text: Moss spots a trail of seed by the bird feeder.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog standing by a wooden bird table, looking at a trail of scattered seed leading away from it.

pages.text: Moss did not drop this seed.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog checking his own paws and spikes, clearly not carrying any seed.

pages.text: Moss sniffs along the trail of seed.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog sniffing closely at the ground, following the line of scattered seed.

pages.text: The trail goes past the old fence.
pages.illustration: The trail of seed continuing along the base of an old wooden garden fence.

pages.text: The trail goes under the garden gate.
pages.illustration: The trail of seed passing underneath a low garden gate.

pages.text: The trail stops by a hole in the ground.
pages.illustration: The trail of seed ending at a small hole in the ground near the fence.

pages.text: Pip pops out of the hole with a seed in his beak.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow popping out of the hole, a single seed held in his beak.

pages.text: Pip drops seed every time he hops.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow hopping along, a small seed dropping from his beak with each hop.

pages.text: Moss grins. Pip made the whole trail.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog grinning at Pip, the trail of seed clearly leading back to the sparrow.

pages.text: Moss and Pip eat seed by the bird feeder.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog and Pip the sparrow eating seed side by side at the base of the bird table.
